name: rtunk
description: A from-scratch, fully open-source rewrite of trunk.io's Code Quality CLI: an orchestrator for linters, formatters, and security scanners behind a single declarative config, with hermetic per-project tool versions, git-aware changed-file checks, output normalization, and caching, built as an auditable, fully local alternative with no telemetry, cloud account, daemon, or self-upgrade. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
